entries.zh: 拘捕、拘执；扣押（兼含逼迫义）
entries.en: to seize, arrest; to take into custody (also: to press, constrain)
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字首字污损（疑'鉍/鉞'），音写栏'guiy sam aiilo'无法对应成词，四栏材料不足，仅可归属 prender（拘捕）词条组。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字两处存疑（疑'鉍/鉞''耒/來'），音写栏'guiy lay cu'难以成词，材料不足，仅可归属 prender（拘捕）词条组。

entries.en: to catch, seize; to capture

entries.zh: 拘縶、缚系；捉而缚之（首字污损存疑）
entries.en: to seize and bind, to fetter

entries.zh: 押解囚犯；擒解（一说解开囚缚、释放，义存疑）
entries.en: to seize and escort a prisoner under guard; (alt.) to unbind and release the captive
to apprehend, arrest (the offender)

entries.zh: 乱抓乱拿；用手乱捉（末字'六'疑为'掠/拿'之讹）
entries.en: to grab and snatch indiscriminately with the hand

entries.zh: 熨火；以烧热铁器烙熨（首字污损，疑为'熨'）
entries.en: hot iron for pressing; to press with a fire-heated iron
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字'鏵'（犁铧）与音写栏'cham'互不相合，亦与西文'prensar ropa'（熨压衣物）义无涉，四栏不一致，不敢强解。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉字作'鏵花'，音写栏'cham hua'与'簪花'（于发髻插花）音义相合，疑为'鏵'之讹，但属存疑推断，不敢定为定释。

entries.en: fetus, unborn young; that which is conceived
pregnant; to have conceived

entries.zh: 肚里有（孩子）；怀有身孕（俗语）
entries.en: to be with child (colloquial: 'there is one in the belly')
pregnant; to be expecting
to be with child, carrying the fetus

entries.zh: 病子：怀子而病、时时呕吐（孕吐、妊娠恶阻）
entries.en: morning sickness; to be sick and vomit while pregnant

entries.zh: 孕，怀孕（音写栏残乱，似含牲畜怀胎例证）
entries.en: pregnant, with young (M column garbled, apparently with examples of animals with young)
pregnant; to conceive (said of the woman, Sp. la mujer)

entries.zh: 身孕，怀胎之身（字面作'身分'，此处当为'身孕'）
entries.en: pregnancy; state of being with child (read as 身孕)
